summary: The 10-20-person manual feasibility study is blocked because no independently verified production College Football 27 catalog release exists. The study protocol, templates, privacy rules, deletion fields, and metric calculations exist, but the required verified catalog, production top-three outputs, and verified build instructions are unavailable.
